ak-ui-2026.name: Alaska Department of Labor, 2026 unemployment insurance tax rates

rules.note: Payroll flag read on the Alaska Department of Labor page: 2026 employee rate 0.50% on a taxable wage base of $54,200.
notes: Alaska's Permanent Fund Dividend is taxable federal income. It is not included here, so federal tax is understated by the tax on your dividend.
Employees pay 0.5% of the first $54,200 of wages into state unemployment insurance, up to $271 a year. Not included.
maintainerNotes: From the PolicyEngine comparison run on 2026-11-12 (oracle/compare.py): PolicyEngine adds about $1,000 of dividend income per adult for Alaska households, raising federal tax by $120 to $480 in the cases tested.
